meta.semantic_model_for_shipped_hierarchies: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (real sentence embeddings, via HF Space)
meta.note: commit hash not tracked in this environment; record at time of git commit.

coherence.design: bibliographic coupling between article pairs via held-out `cites` relation (never used in clustering); provenance guard: no article's placement may derive from `cites`; permutation null over cluster labels (10,000 permutations)
coherence.result: null at every snapshot (best case 2026: z=1.68, p=0.059) -- reported as a null result, not significant coherence evidence.

stability.note: T3's event log (temporal_events.json) is built DIRECTLY from the shipped hierarchy_<year>.json files, not a separate re-clustering.

authoritative_perturbation_test.method: per-snapshot null: re-cluster after removing 10% of post-merge clustering-eligible edges (real MiniLM embeddings via subset matching); each transition tested against both endpoint nulls, conservative p = max, Holm-adjusted across transitions
authoritative_perturbation_test.interpretation: 0/3 transitions are more stable than their own snapshots' 10%-edge-removal noise after Holm correction. The earlier claim that 2022->2024 is robustly stable (p=0.03) came from comparing against the 2026 null, which is much less stable than the 2022/2024 nulls, and is withdrawn. perturbation removes 10% of edges; real growth adds 40-92% across these transitions -- not a matched-magnitude comparison

superseded.2026_only_null: Earlier versions tested every transition against the 2026 null only; 2022->2024 then gave p=0.03 (primary), which (a) did not survive multiple-testing correction (Holm/BH adjusted p=0.089) and (b) used a null ~0.26 ARI less stable than the 2022/2024 snapshots' own nulls. Kept in t3_perturbation_real_embeddings.json as p_vs_2026_null_SUPERSEDED.
superseded.lambda_sweep_file: outputs/lambda_selection_and_null.json is LEGACY: produced by src/temporal_reg.py (raw-edge perturbation, which breaks embedding subset matching; 13/20 seeds collapse to ARI=0) on an older pipeline state; its observed transition ARIs (0.82/0.44/0.50) do not match the shipped hierarchies (see above), so its growth-null comparison is NOT reported as evidence. Only its decision (lambda_sd=0, i.e. no temporal regularisation) is used, and that decision is the untuned default.

method_sensitivity.decision: documented, not changed: both fixes re-cluster/re-assign every snapshot and invalidate existing labels; see report.md, Limitations.

labels.method: LLM labeller sees only member surface forms; each named entity in a gloss is checked against the member list and against independent `claims` text (article_year <= cutoff) with src/faithfulness_check.py. Entity-level check, not NLI of relationships.
labels.levels_2_3: deterministic template labels from verbatim member forms (label_source='template'); outside the T5 faithfulness scope

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: Tensorial & Magnetic Atomic Cluster Expansion
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: Extends the Atomic Cluster Expansion framework to represent vectorial and tensorial atomic properties—including magnetic moments and charge transfer—for building interatomic potentials that predict energies, forces, and torques.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Directly supported by claims describing ACE generalized to scalar/vectorial/tensorial properties with magnetic moments and charges; no unsupported specifics asserted.

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: Equivariant/Directional Message-Passing GNNs for Molecules
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: Graph neural network architectures—directional and SE(3)/E(3)-equivariant message passing—for predicting molecular properties and DFT Hamiltonians, evaluated largely on QM9.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: CORRECTED after external review found evidence was missed on first pass: full 44-claim list confirms QM9 evaluation. The word 'largely' is a mild, hard-to-verify quantifier, worth softening in future passes, but not an unsupported fact.

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: Machine Learning for Multiscale Computational Modeling (Survey)
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: A survey-level cluster covering machine learning methods (neural networks, generative models, transfer/meta-learning) applied to multiscale computational modeling tasks such as fluid mechanics, materials microstructure, and manufacturing, along with associated challenges like data scarcity and limited extrapolation.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Consistent with claims describing ML as a surrogate/accelerant in multiscale modeling, CNN-based materials microstructure estimation, and memory/computation-cost challenges.

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: Differentiable Density Functional Theory (D4FT)
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: Methods for a GPU-accelerated, automatically-differentiable SCF-DFT implementation (D4FT), including neural local scaling and stochastic optimization, compared against established DFT packages (GPAW, Psi4).
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: CORRECTED after external review found evidence was missed on first pass: full 12-claim list confirms the GPAW/Psi4/PySCF comparison directly.

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: Equivariant Message-Passing MLIPs at Scale (MACE/SevenNet Family)
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: Equivariant graph neural network interatomic potentials (including MACE-style higher-order message passing and SevenNet) with techniques for GPU parallelization and scalable training, addressing computational efficiency and generalization challenges in machine-learned interatomic potentials.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Systematic entity check (7 articles, 89 claims): MACE (9 supporting claims), SevenNet (11), equivariant (10), ACE (16) all GROUNDED_AND_SUPPORTED; 'GPU parallelization' as an exact phrase is GROUNDED_BUT_UNVERIFIABLE (GPU and parallel/parallelization each individually well-supported, 8 and 7 claims respectively, but not as one exact phrase) -- not an overclaim, but illustrates a real limitation of substring-based checking for compound phrases.

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: Generalization Challenges in Long-Range MLIPs (Charge, Chemical Space)
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: Reviews and addresses generalization challenges for machine-learned interatomic potentials, particularly long-range electrostatic and charge-transfer prediction, chemical-space under-sampling bias, and accelerating DFT-NEB-based geometry/barrier calculations.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Systematic entity check (3 articles, 90 claims): long-range (8), chemical space (2), DFT-NEB (1), generalization (1) all GROUNDED_AND_SUPPORTED; charge-transfer is GROUNDED_BUT_UNVERIFIABLE (a real member term, but no claim happens to mention it directly).

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: AFLOW High-Throughput Materials Discovery Framework
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: An automated high-throughput DFT calculation framework (AFLOW) with standardized protocols, covering electronic-structure methods (DFT+U, GW approximation) and phonon/symmetry analysis tools for materials discovery.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Systematic entity check (3 articles, 40 claims): AFLOW (16), DFT+U (4), phonon (1), symmetry (1), high-throughput (1) all GROUNDED_AND_SUPPORTED; GW approximation is GROUNDED_BUT_UNVERIFIABLE (a real member term, no claim happens to mention it directly).

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: EquiformerV2: Equivariant Transformer for High-Degree Representations
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: An equivariant graph transformer (EquiformerV2) using higher-degree tensor representations, attention re-normalization, and denoising pre-training for scalable, accurate atomic property prediction.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Systematic entity check (38 claims): EquiformerV2 (7), attention re-normalization (2), equivariant (3), higher-degree (1) GROUNDED_AND_SUPPORTED; denoising is GROUNDED_BUT_UNVERIFIABLE.

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: DeePMD-kit: Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics Software
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: Software package (DeePMD-kit) for Deep Potential models, incorporating active learning, automated model selection, and molecular dynamics analysis techniques (e.g. Arrhenius plot analysis, mean-squared-displacement regression) for materials simulation workflows.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Systematic entity check (78 claims): DeePMD-kit (6), Deep Potential (2), molecular dynamics (6) GROUNDED_AND_SUPPORTED; active learning and Arrhenius are GROUNDED_BUT_UNVERIFIABLE.

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: Universal Graph-Based ML Interatomic Potentials & DFT Surrogates
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: A broad collection of graph neural network interatomic potentials and deep-learning DFT surrogates (including M3GNet, CHGNet, DeepH, D4FT, and Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics) spanning universal materials modeling, charge-informed potentials, and multiscale bridging from first-principles to continuum simulations.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Systematic entity check (16 articles, 210 claims): M3GNet (15), CHGNet (13), DeepH (24), D4FT (10) all strongly GROUNDED_AND_SUPPORTED; 'Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics', 'multiscale', 'charge-informed' are GROUNDED_BUT_UNVERIFIABLE.

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: Materials Databases & Universal Simulation Infrastructure
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: Infrastructure for materials data and simulation, spanning materials databases (Materials Project), universal atomistic simulation frameworks (Orb-v3), and universal atomic models (UMA), including toolkit/agent components for automated materials workflows.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Systematic entity check (5 articles, 68 claims): Materials Project (8), Orb-v3 (10), UMA (12), agent (1) GROUNDED_AND_SUPPORTED; toolkit is GROUNDED_BUT_UNVERIFIABLE.

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: Graph Neural Networks for Molecular & Crystal Property Prediction
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: Graph neural network frameworks for predicting molecular and crystalline material properties, including phonon spectra, structural defects, and general-purpose message-passing architectures (e.g. MEGNet-style universal frameworks, virtual-node GNNs).
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Systematic entity check (20 articles, 279 claims): phonon (21), crystal (29), message-passing (2), graph neural network (3), virtual node (2) all GROUNDED_AND_SUPPORTED; 'structural defects' is GROUNDED_BUT_UNVERIFIABLE. Note: this is a large, heterogeneous cluster (20 articles) -- the gloss is intentionally general rather than asserting specific findings, given the breadth.

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: AI/ML Foundation Models & Benchmarking for Materials Science
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: Broad survey and infrastructure cluster covering AI foundation models for materials science, benchmarking datasets (e.g. Matbench), and multiscale modeling reviews spanning solid-state physics and chemistry.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Systematic entity check (21 articles, 296 claims): foundation model (5), Matbench (17), multiscale (4), benchmark (15), survey (1) all GROUNDED_AND_SUPPORTED. HONEST CAVEAT: with 21 articles and 941 members, this is less a single coherent 'idea' and more a broad catch-all bucket -- a real, structural limitation of forcing a corpus this size into ~10-15 top-level clusters (P2's budget), not a labelling defect. Worth stating explicitly in the report rather than dressing up a broad bucket as a tight topic.

legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.label: Interatomic Potentials for Atomic Transport & Diffusion Simulation
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.gloss: A large, heterogeneous cluster of foundational machine-learned interatomic potentials applied to atomic transport, migration barriers, and diffusion in crystalline/solid-state materials, including neural network potentials and flow-matching-based simulation acceleration.
legacy_pilot_2026_L0_detail.faithfulness_note: Systematic entity check (39 articles, 545 claims): migration barrier (8), diffusion (7), atomic transport (1) GROUNDED_AND_SUPPORTED; 'flow matching' and 'neural network potential' are GROUNDED_BUT_UNVERIFIABLE (real member terms, no direct claim match). HONEST CAVEAT: 39 articles in one cluster is the most extreme case of the same P2-budget-forced heterogeneity noted for cluster 11 -- this label captures a real common theme (transport/diffusion) but cannot represent the full diversity of 39 papers as one 'coherent scientific idea' in the sense the task originally asks for.

extrinsic.conclusion: NULL / UNINFORMATIVE RESULT: TF-IDF gives zero lexical similarity between natural-language questions and short technical target names for the large majority of targets, so neither system can retrieve them regardless of cost. This is a scorer limitation, not a finding about the hierarchy's usefulness. A denser embedding scorer is needed before this comparison is informative.
extrinsic.caveat: An earlier version of this script reported a positive-looking result (hierarchical beating flat at low cost) that was an artifact of non-deterministic Python set iteration order breaking ties among zero-similarity candidates — corrected here.
